sections.title: Student Affairs: Supporting Student Success & Engagement
sections.description: Student affairs offices and professionals in higher education institutions provide undergraduate and graduate students a myriad of ways to receive support and education outside of the classroom. From career services to cultural centers to religious and spiritual life to wellness to athletics to disability services and beyond, there are many sub-specialties in the field, each with their own standards, strengths, and challenges. In this course, we will delve into the ways in which student affairs supports student success (academically and socially) and engagement (via sense of belonging and purpose). This dynamic course will include lively class discussions, visits from experts and practitioners in the field, and opportunities to deeply examine the student affairs sub-specialties that each student is particularly interested in. Students will take away both breadth and depth about the field of student affairs, as well as knowledge about what strategies particularly impact students’ success and campus engagement.
